international.title: Washington DC shooting latest updates: multiple people shot in Logan Circle
international.summary: Police are looking for suspect after incident at Logan Circle, one mile north of the White House Multiple people shot in Washington DC as police warn people to stay inside James Spellman was at the gym a little after 8am when he heard shots being fired. He said there were about 50 people in the gym at the time, reported AP. “Within seconds there was a man who fell to the ground, and a pool of blood came out,” he said. “One gym member rushed to help him. He was instantly dead. He had been shot in the neck.” Continue reading...
